answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The anchor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean.
